aws_ecs_service.this.why: modules/ecs-service: the deploy, promote and restart workflows roll out new task definitions, and autoscaling sets the task count (ignore_changes there).

aws_service_discovery_service.this.why: modules/ecs-service: AWS fills it in after create (ignore_changes there).

aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.placeh.why: infra-live-backend secrets.tf: Terraform writes a placeholder once; scripts/fill-service-secrets.sh puts the real values in as a new version (ignore_changes there).

aws_ssm_parameter.generation_switch.why: infra-live-backend generation_switch.tf: the LLM kill switch, turned off and on by hand (docs/infra-operations.md, ignore_changes there).

aws_elasticache_replication_group.this.why: modules/redis: set only by the zone retry (scripts/valkey-capacity.sh) and read only at create (ignore_changes there).
